sections.title: Our Services
sections.content: At Latitude Zero Cottages Kikorongo, we offer more than just a place to stay. Our goal is to provide a comprehensive experience that blends comfort, relaxation, and adventure in one of Uganda most beautiful regions.
sections.meta_description: Latitude Zero Cottages offers comfortable rooms, dining, safari adventures, and amenities near Queen Elizabeth National Park.

sections.title: Rooms & Cottages
sections.content:
Built for rest after a long day in the park. Clean, comfortable, and close at hand.

---
images/IMG_3384.jpeg|Standard Room|1 double bed · En-suite shower · 2 guests · Breakfast included. Clean, comfortable, and ideal for couples or solo travellers.|From $45/night
images/IMG_3385.jpeg|Deluxe Room|1 king bed · En-suite bathroom · 2 guests · Breakfast + fruit basket · Scenic garden view. Our most popular upgrade.|From $65/night
images/IMG_3388.jpeg|Family Cottage|2 twin beds + 1 double · Private sitting area · 4 guests · Breakfast + dinner included · Veranda with park views.|From $85/night

sections.title: Dining
sections.content:
Locally sourced ingredients, freshly prepared. We cater to all diets and group sizes.

---
images/IMG_3383.jpeg|Local & International Cuisine|From hearty Ugandan staples to international favourites — everything is cooked fresh on site.|Meals from $8/person
images/IMG_3384.jpeg|Family Dining|Generous portions, kid-friendly options, and a relaxed atmosphere. We can accommodate dietary requirements with advance notice.|Group bookings welcome

sections.title: Game Drives & Safari Access
sections.content:
Your doorstep is 1 km from the main park gate — the shortest transfer in the area.

---
fas fa-car|Park Transfers|We arrange transfers to and from the park gate on request.
fas fa-binoculars|Game Drive Booking|Our team books your game drive slots and park permits in advance.
fas fa-user-friends|Local Guides|Experienced Ugandan guides who know the park's best routes and wildlife patterns.
fas fa-ticket-alt|Park Permits|We handle your QENP permit paperwork so you arrive ready to go.
fas fa-phone|Arrival Coordination|Call or WhatsApp us on arrival — we'll guide you straight to your room.

sections.title: Amenities
sections.content:
Everything you need — Wi-Fi, hot water, secure parking, and a team who knows the park inside out.

---
fas fa-wifi|24/7 High-Speed Wi-Fi|Reliable connection for work calls, streaming, and staying in touch.
fas fa-snowflake|Hot Water Showers|Geyser-backed hot water in every room, any time of day.
fas fa-parking|Free Secure Parking|On-site parking for cars and safari vehicles.
fas fa-concierge-bell|Concierge Service|Game drive bookings, restaurant reservations, and park advice — all handled for you.
fas fa-shield-alt|24/7 Security|Night security and gated access for peace of mind.
